_meta.note: Phase A is SPECIFICATION, not implementation. Phase B tests the specification against the four deterministic cases already found. No new randomized trials.

content.input_type: K_t : semantic content of the knowledge state
content.bot: ¬p ∈ Content(K_t)   — an EXPLICIT negation, not an absence
content.conflict_behaviour: if both p and ¬p ∈ Content(K_t) the class is INCOHERENT as stated — see PB-2; a contradiction value is not in the codomain
content.temporal_dependency: none as stated — but Content is time-indexed in K_t, so this is UNDER-SPECIFIED
content.factivity_requirement: NONE — content membership is not truth

evidence.input_type: Evidence(K_t,p) plus an admissibility condition E_min
evidence.u: evidence exists but does not decide E_min — **existence ≠ sufficiency**
evidence.conflict_behaviour: conflicting evidence yields U, never an average
evidence.temporal_dependency: YES — evidence may expire (**CE-3: no retirement relation exists**)
evidence.factivity_requirement: NONE — and this is where CE-1 originates: E_min can be met by a false report

provenance.input_type: Π(p), the provenance record of p
provenance.conflict_behaviour: two sources of differing authority ⇒ U unless π_min ranks them
provenance.note: MUST NOT be confused with provenance-sensitive equivalence ≅_λ: Sat asks 'does this state have the required provenance', ≅_λ asks 'are two states equivalent under provenance'

status.input_type: ES(p,K_t), the epistemic status of p
status.blocker: **⪰ IS NOT DEFINED BY THE THEORY.** Any implementation invents it.

consistency.u: Contr cannot be evaluated — **unknown contradiction ≠ no contradiction**
consistency.conflict_behaviour: this class IS the conflict class; the open question is whether a fourth value C is needed (review: HYPOTHESIS, not a choice)
consistency.temporal_dependency: YES — p true@t1 and false@t2 is not a contradiction
consistency.blocker: Contr is not defined; and whether contradiction needs a 4th value is OPEN

governance.u: **no authority supplied** — and governance satisfaction may NOT be inferred from content
governance.conflict_behaviour: competing authorities ⇒ U; resolution is NORMATIVE
governance.blocker: no evaluator exists; this is why every governance requirement read U in E1

temporal.input_type: a temporal interpretation of K_t over an interval I
temporal.u: temporal evidence insufficient, **or no temporal semantics defined**
temporal.conflict_behaviour: true@t1 / false@t2 is NOT a contradiction — it is a temporal fact
temporal.blocker: no temporal semantics defined; this is the second source of U in E1

operational.input_type: δ(K_t,o), the state after operation o
operational.top: δ defined ∧ applicable ∧ postcondition κ met
operational.bot: δ defined ∧ applicable ∧ κ not met
operational.u: **δ undefined or inapplicable — U, NEVER automatically ⊥**
operational.blocker: δ is Step 290 and is open; this is the third source of U in E1
operational.note: RECURSIVE: Sat_op is defined via Sat_κ, so the family is not flat
